met-when.says: A discrete network-space application lets its intended user publish, discover, retrieve, verify and navigate SCA/SEN-addressed linked information with preserved provenance and authority.

Semiotic content-addressed network-space application demonstrates parity with each named target on its relevant user workflows against identified baselines and workloads, with independent receiving evidence.

After parity is established for each target, Semiotic content-addressed network-space application demonstrates a material user-relevant improvement under comparable conditions while retaining parity capabilities.

x-provenance.intended-capability: A usable network node and navigable space over semantic identities: publish, discover, retrieve, verify and traverse linked content with provenance and authority. Compose HTTP transport; retain SignCell/SignChain/SignGraph identity and evidence semantics. Product name and exact app boundary remain design decisions.
x-provenance.derivation: The subject is grounded in the observed owner or explicitly desired application. Target selections extend the Leader's named comparisons under the quoted delegation. Existing requirements remain additive. Manifest descriptions describe current source and do not determine the intended design.
qualification-gaps: Target identities and capability domains are selected; exact baseline versions, workloads, measures and receiving operations remain to be specified.

No comparative receiving command or evidence is attached; satisfaction remains unsettled. Native schema admission remains unreceived after the previously recorded semantic-content-identity export failure.
